'expected_predecessor_snapshot_id'::text AND (publication_reference ->> 'request_fingerprint'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text OR status = 'SUPERSEDED'::text AND publication_status = 'STALE'::text AND publication_reference = '{}'::jsonb OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::text, 'RUNNING'::text, 'RETRYABLE'::text, 'FAILED'::text])) AND publication_status = 'NOT_REQUESTED'::text AND publication_reference = '{}'::jsonb, false)

relations.view:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (course_id) course_id,
    display_name,
    location,
    catalog_status,
    identity_source,
    catalog_revision
   FROM ( SELECT value.course_id,
            value.display_name,
            value.location,
            value.catalog_status,
            value.identity_source,
            value.catalog_revision,
            1 AS priority
           FROM scoring_authority.global_course_catalog_v1 value
        UNION ALL
         SELECT tee.course_id,
            tee.display_name,
            tee.location,
            'ACTIVE'::text AS text,
            'PRESERVED_EXISTING'::text AS text,
            (1)::bigint AS int8,
            2
           FROM scoring_authority.tournament_setup_course_tees_v1 tee
        UNION ALL
         SELECT identity.course_id,
            identity.canonical_name,
            identity.canonical_location,
            'ACTIVE'::text AS text,
            'PRESERVED_EXISTING'::text AS text,
            (1)::bigint AS int8,
            3
           FROM scoring_authority.completed_history_course_identities identity
        UNION ALL
         SELECT snapshot.course_id,
            snapshot.course_id,
            NULL::text AS text,
            'ACTIVE'::text AS text,
            'PRESERVED_EXISTING'::text AS text,
            (1)::bigint AS int8,
            4
           FROM scoring_authority.scoring_snapshots snapshot) source
  WHERE ((course_id IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(course_id) <> ''::text))
  ORDER BY course_id, priority;
